locked_conventions.source_interval: [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure and zero extension; the zero-Lebesgue-integral source correction and actual source Gram C^*C are retained
locked_conventions.physical_interval: I_lambda=[-log(lambda),log(lambda)] with Lebesgue measure in logarithmic coordinates, equivalently du/u on [lambda^(-1),lambda]
locked_conventions.fourier_sign: fhat(t)=integral f(x)*exp(-i*t*x)dx with Plancherel measure dt/(2*pi)
locked_conventions.inversion: J is reflection in logarithmic coordinates; Fourier residue classes are not substituted for inversion parity
locked_conventions.prime_endpoint: every prime power n<=lambda^2 is retained; the cutoff is inclusive and is not confused with lambda
locked_conventions.pole_signs: the inversion-even pole is +2|p_plus><p_plus| and the inversion-odd pole is -2|p_minus><p_minus|
locked_conventions.source_gram: every source synthesis C uses C^*C; it is never replaced by the identity unless orthonormality is proved
locked_conventions.strictness: equality at a target floor, rank-one load one, exact coframe-loss norm one, zero determinant, or nonpositive reserve is rejected
locked_conventions.input_text: lambda numerator and decimal precision are canonical positive integer text; binary64 inputs and JSON numbers are rejected
locked_conventions.input_limits: the finite oracle admits 3<=lambda_numerator<=999999 and 50<=dps<=1000, with length and range checked before integer conversion or interval initialization
locked_conventions.runtime_version: the interval runtime must report mpmath==1.4.1 exactly; a mismatch is rejected before any interval probe
locked_conventions.artifact_scope: exact finite-dimensional reductions and outward interval probes, not a physical prolate-Weil matrix, growing-schedule estimate, signed sector floor, or asymptotic theorem
locked_conventions.arithmetic: finite fixtures use exact reduced rationals; logarithms and derived formula probes use outward mpmath.iv intervals; binary64 JSON numbers are forbidden

locked_formulas.cap_free_even_floor: E_H(nu)=integral (nu*L-w)_+*kappa_H*dnu and P_H*(Q_plus-U*I)*P_H>=(nu*L-E_H(nu))*I; E_H(nu)<(nu-mu)*L gives a strict mu*L floor
locked_formulas.source_tail_competitor: if T @ B_X=I, F=ran(C), and W=T @ C, then E_H<=||T @ (I-P_F) @ B_X @ sqrt(D_nu)||_HS^2
locked_formulas.central_trace_necessity: if d_nu>=(A_lambda_nu_delta)*1_(|t|<=delta/L) with A_lambda_nu_delta>0, then E_H>=A_lambda_nu_delta*trace(P_H*T_1band*P_H), forcing trace<(nu-mu)*L/A_lambda_nu_delta
locked_formulas.exact_coframe_loss: with e=(I-P_E)1, s=||P_E*1||^2, F=E intersect 1^perp, and A=(I-P_E)Z^*, Z @ Z^*=I, Z^*X subset 1^perp: Z @ (I-P_F) @ Z^*=A^*A+(A^*e)(A^*e)^*/s
locked_formulas.coframe_scalar_sufficient: rho=||A||^2 and beta_E=||A^*e||^2/s; rho+beta_E<1 is sufficient and no stronger than Theta=(2*lambda/s)*rho<1
locked_formulas.shifted_odd_floor: for c>a>beta>=0, 0<=R<=(c-a)*L*I, q=(c-beta)*L, h=(a-beta)*L, M_beta=q*I-R: c*L*I-R-2|p><p|>beta*L*I iff 2<p,M_beta^(-1)p><1
locked_formulas.shifted_chord: with mu0=||p||^2, rho1=<p,Rp>, chi_beta=<p,((c-a)*L*I-R)*R*(q*I-R)^(-1)p>, the load is 2*(h*mu0+rho1-chi_beta)/(h*q)
locked_formulas.moment_hierarchy: U_k=2*(sum_(j=0)^(k-1) rho_j/q^(j+1)+rho_k/(h*q^k)) decreases non-strictly to the shifted odd load with the explicit positive remainder
locked_formulas.load_one_boundary: 2*<p,M_beta^(-1)p>=1 is singular and never passes the strict shifted odd floor; the required odd pole is subtracted, never added
locked_formulas.aligned_positive_excess: for A_plus>=0, S=M_beta^(-1/2)*A_plus*M_beta^(-1/2), z=M_beta^(-1/2)*p, the compensated load is 2||z||^2-2<z,S*(I+S)^(-1)z>
locked_formulas.shifted_one_direction: for e_p=p/||p|| and M_beta_actual=M-beta*L*I, strict floor is equivalent to C_beta>0 and alpha_beta-2||p||^2-<b,C_beta^(-1)b>>0
locked_formulas.shifted_transverse_block: every block in the one-direction Schur complement is formed from M-beta*L*I; retaining an unshifted transverse block is rejected
